name: pre-edit-recorded-content-missing-from-disk-carries-the-notice
description: Session A's first read of CLAUDE.md seeds v1 with A's hash, which is not the bytes on disk. A then pre-edits: after the admitted acquire the coordinator hashes the file itself, finds the recorded content gone with no commit to explain it, and adds disk_differs with the out-of-band notice as context only. Both backends (cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#205).

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: ⚠ CLAUDE.md on disk differs from v1, the last content committed through the coordinator, and no session committed the change: it was made outside the coordinator. Read CLAUDE.md before relying on it, and do not write it from an earlier read; that write would replace the change.
